title: Sharp diagrams from plain text
summary: Write Mermaid in the editor and see a crisp SVG diagram as you type, right inside Confluence or Jira.
caption: An architecture flowchart written in Mermaid and rendered as a vector diagram.

title: Use the diagrams already on the page
summary: Mermaid code blocks on the page are found automatically, in page order. Click one to edit and render it.
caption: Two Mermaid code blocks found on the page, with the sequence diagram rendered.

title: Light or dark, zoom and 4x export
summary: Switch between light and dark themes, zoom from 25% to 400%, open full screen, and export a 4x PNG or an SVG.
caption: A document review workflow in the light theme.
